_doc: Device limits for common/ceiling.py --device (and events_summary.py --device): one file per GPU target, one profile per power setting. A profile replaces the kit lanes.json's 'hardware' block, so a lane's floor is the one this machine can reach at that setting. wmma_f16_tflops is derived from the clock when a profile gives clock_ghz and no TFLOP/s: simds x wmma_flop / wmma_cycles x clock. Every number names its source (HRX-like LEDGER rows).
name: Strix Halo, Radeon 8060S, gfx1151 (40 CUs, 80 SIMDs, LPDDR5X unified)
_src_simds_per_occupancy_domain: Loom kernels run in WGP mode (kernel descriptor COMPUTE_PGM_RSRC1 bit 29): a workgroup spreads over one WGP's 4 SIMDs, the compile report's LDS 'occupancy domain' (devices/gfx1151.md). lint_counters (d2) quantizes residency tiers with it and checks its tiers against the report's per-resource independent_tier (HRX-like E533).
_src_wmma: f16 WMMA 16x16x16: 8,192 FLOP per instruction, 32 cycles per SIMD (E369)

cap85w._src_chain: ceiling.py's latency-chain term. launch_gap_us: start of a served dispatch minus the end of the one before it, median of 95 decode submissions (~1,196 dispatches each; p10 0.72, p90 0.76, none negative: the queue serialises them), static-1123/abba-e310/1-u60q (E328). global_load_latency_ns: unknown. No HRX-like LEDGER row gives a DRAM load round trip in ns: rocprof's VmemLoadLatency read 0 on every global-load kernel until E411 fixed its definition, and it has not been re-measured since; E83 / E139 / E168 ablations time whole kernels (no-load, cache-resident, no-page-map variants), not one trip. Measure it (counters.sh latency preset, or a pointer-chase probe) before filling it in
cap85w._src: the default 85 W PPT cap: served prefill and decode both run pinned at 84-85 W, clock median 2.12-2.19 GHz (E356, E358, E373); 2.14 GHz -> 43.8 TFLOP/s (E369); pure reads 239.8 GB/s cool and 239.6 hot after a 10-minute 85 W soak (E380: bandwidth does not drop with heat)

nominal._src: the figures the kit lanes.json files carry: 228 GB/s reached by decode matvecs (E50), ~45 TFLOP/s clock-adjusted (E61); they assume a clock the chip does not hold inside 85 W (E358)
